title.narrative: National Cleaner Production Programme (NCPP): Bosnia and Herzegovina

description.narrative: The project is designed to foster expertise, service delivery capacity and implementation of RECP practices and policies in the country, building on UNIDO#s experience in supporting National Cleaner Production Programmes (NCPCs/ NCPPs) in collaboration with UNEP, under the global joint RECP programme (http://www.unido.org/cp.html), operational in over 50 developing countries and countries with economy in transition, including Central and Eastern Europe. The programme develops capacity to foster the deployment of RECP methods, practices, technologies and policies through information dissemination, professional training, plant level assessments and demonstration projects, policy advise and support for Environmentally Sound Technologies (ESTs), including investments. The implementation of in-country activities takes place under the guidance and in-cooperation with the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Relations. Specific activities include, among others, awareness raising activities, training of National trainee experts to be trained on execution of RECP assessments, execution of RECP assessments at selected enterprises, and policy review.
